recognize_zh: 四格影像中箭頭所指的嗜中性球，細胞質內吞入一顆均質、淡紫紅色、無染色質結構的圓形 LE 小體（LE body），把分葉核擠到邊緣呈新月形，即 LE 細胞（LE cell）。
features: Neutrophils containing a large, round, homogeneous, glassy magenta-purple intracytoplasmic inclusion (LE body) lacking chromatin texture
Host neutrophil nucleus compressed and displaced to the periphery, forming a crescent around the ingested material
Engulfed body occupies most of the cell volume, larger than the host nucleus in several cells
Panel D shows a cluster of neutrophils around homogeneous nuclear material (rosette-like arrangement)
Background of mature neutrophils, lymphocytes and erythrocytes without blasts
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears (panels A-D) show several neutrophils that have phagocytosed a single large, round, smooth, homogeneous purple-magenta inclusion devoid of chromatin pattern, with the host lobulated nucleus pushed to the periphery as a crescent. Panel D shows a small cluster of neutrophils aggregated around similar denatured nuclear material. No blasts or significant dysplasia are evident in these fields. The findings represent lupus erythematosus (LE) cells and are suggestive of systemic lupus erythematosus; correlation with ANA, anti-dsDNA and complement levels is recommended.

ddx.vs: In a tart cell (usually a monocyte/macrophage) the ingested nucleus retains visible chromatin structure and a nuclear outline, whereas the LE body is homogeneous and structureless.
Hemophagocytosis is performed by large macrophages ingesting intact erythrocytes, platelets or whole cells, not by neutrophils containing a single smooth homogeneous nuclear mass.

ddx.dx: Neutrophil phagocytosing apoptotic cell or ingested bacteria/fungi
ddx.vs: Apoptotic bodies are dense pyknotic fragments and organisms are small and uniform, unlike the single large glassy LE body.

ddx.dx: Binucleate or giant neutrophil / artifact overlap
ddx.vs: Overlapping cells show two separate cell membranes and chromatin texture, whereas the LE body lies within the neutrophil cytoplasm and indents its nucleus.
